parameters.question: Compare posterior Beta parameters (alpha, beta) and mean binding probability for antibodies X (41/60, Beta(1,1) prior -> Beta(42,20), mean ~0.6774) and Y (33/60 -> Beta(34,28), mean ~0.5484). Values must match within +/-0.001; row/column order and naming may differ. Any Monte Carlo P(X>Y) value is stochastic and should be compared loosely.

Beta(1,1) priors; antibody X 41/60, Y 33/60. Report posterior Beta parameters (X: Beta(42,20), Y: Beta(34,28)) and posterior means (~0.677, ~0.548), then the Monte Carlo fraction P(X>Y) from 10,000 draws. Posterior parameters must match within +/-0.001; P(X>Y) must be within +/-0.05 of the reference (simulation noise is expected).
